name: Computer Science
summary: Computer Science studies computation, algorithms, and software. Students learn to design and analyze programs and systems that solve problems.
description: Computer Science majors learn programming in several languages and study data structures, algorithms, discrete mathematics, computer systems and architecture, operating systems, programming languages, and the theory of computation. Upper-level electives cover areas such as artificial intelligence and machine learning, databases, networks, security, graphics, human-computer interaction, and distributed systems. Team software projects and a capstone are common, and many students complete internships. Computer science graduates are among the most sought-after in the job market and work in technology companies and nearly every other industry.
